descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S11 「服务端的重新分配规则：再分给同一个病人、加了字、另一个病人、空框」 Re-assign rules on the server: same patient again, more words, another patient, empty box

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Re-assign works: re-assigning a box to a different patient adds its text to the new patient's encounter note and leaves it in the first patient's note. …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 6；TFA-92582 step 6）
  • T2 If more is dictated into a box after it was assigned, only the new words are added when it is assigned again.（TFA-92582 AC 6；TFA-92582 step 7）
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Tim's API tests on the template-isolation account

When Cells: same patient + nothing new; same patient + words added at the end; different patient; A → B → A; box rewritten; empty box assigned then filled

Then Nothing new → chart unchanged; words added → only the new words appended; different patient → whole box on B, A keeps its copy, mark moves to B; empty box → marked, chart untouched, later words do go

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright API assertions on encounterNotes and assignedPatientId (U5, T2, U2 marked). The same tests also expect A → B → A to leave two copies on A and a rewritten box to be appended in full; those cells encode the app's choice for Q5, so a green run does not accept them. These two cells are the evidence for Q5(a) and Q5(b); S12 does not repeat them

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
